title: Colorado Wage Act (Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 8, Article 4 - Wages)
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents in a browser: 'Title 8. Labor and Industry (ss 8-1-101 - 8-88-306)' > 'LABOR I - Department of Labor and Employment' > 'Wages (Arts. 4 - 10)' > 'Article 4. Wages (ss 8-4-101 - 8-4-127)', listed live alongside Article 5 Wage Equality, Article 6 Minimum Wages of Workers (ss 8-6-101 - 8-6-120), Article 9 Assignment of Wages and Article 10 Preferred Claims.
notes: Article 4 is the Colorado Wage Act: pay periods, wage statements, deductions, final pay on separation and the wage-claim process. Minimum wage is Article 6 plus Colo. Const. art. XVIII s 15 and the COMPS Order (7 CCR 1103-1); only one statute per topic is listed.
